cases.name: form-action
cases.request: Add a CSS-only common button named Preview preferences inside form#preferences. It must not submit the form. Preserve the existing save behavior and accessible markup. Do not add JavaScript for this action.

cases.name: navigation-media
cases.request: Refine this account dashboard's responsive navigation and hero image loading. The bar and rail currently overlap at wide widths, and the prominent hero has no dimensions and is lazy-loaded. Show exactly one peer navigation at Compact and Expanded widths, preserve all three destinations and existing identity/content/actions, reserve the hero's intrinsic 1200 by 600 ratio and avoid delaying its loading. Capture before/after evidence and check 839px and 840px. Keep changes limited to these defects.

provenance.limits: Installed package manifests and expected browser revision are hashed; external service state and the actual Codex/browser binaries are not fingerprinted.

preliminary.reason: Native Codex inventory helpers misclassified by the original grader; stopped at a provenance boundary. Original grades retained, excluded from the fresh comparison.

Operator elapsed includes fixture preparation, independent browser checks and cleanup; agent seconds cover the CLI adapter only. Review time is separate.
